headline: This build adds a Guild Wars 2 theme for BetterBags Next when the GW2_UI addon is installed.

entries.title: Guild Wars 2 theme
entries.details: Adds a Guild Wars 2 theme for BetterBags Next, available whenever the GW2_UI addon is installed. It uses GW2_UI window artwork, custom item button borders, client fonts, and places header action buttons on a vertical side panel.
